chapter: Haiti, Artie Shaw and Los Angeles work
title: Recording with singers in California
summary: He recorded with Carmen McRae, Julie London, Patti Page, Ramsey Lewis and Nancy Wilson.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: So that was a very rewarding experience, and then I left. After that I came to California and stayed. I'm still here and I've done quite a bit of recording out here. And I recorded with -- speaking of singers, I did some recording with Carmen out here on Jimmy Jones' date.

"People who live on the hill," Stardust. Beautiful, beautiful. Jimmie really wrote some beautiful things on (inaudible). And I recorded with Carmen in New York before I came out here. I think Ted Dameron did a date for her, and I recorded with her. And I recorded with Julie London, as a matter of fact I had quite a few solos on her records, you know. I think she was recording for Liberty then. I think the last one was "Body and Soul," that was the name of the album.
And let's see, who else. The singers. Patti Page. I joined Patti Page -- did I tell you -- we went through that. Well, I did quite a bit of recording also with her, and I

recorded with Ramsey Lewis out here, and I think on this date it was Ramsey Lewis and Eddie Harris, the saxophone player. It was a very good date. And I have done so many recordings with Nancy Wilson, you know, I've just -- I was on her television show. She just stopped recently because she's pregnant. She's expecting now. And I think she' going to have another show when she's ready, you know, and everything is over.
